study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: use of an evidence-based inpatient obstetric intervention
Day of the week (weekday vs. weekend)
outcome: Use of a cesarean risk calculator
cohort: 822 women admitted to the labor and delivery unit during the postimplementation period (July 1, 2018-June 30, 2019)
finding: Daily weekday audit and feedback for the implementation of an evidence-based inpatient obstetric intervention was found to have a sustained impact over the weekends.
